about: Labelled reader messages for scripts/decke-triage-eval.mjs. SYNTHETIC: written the way Pokemon TCG players write, never copied from a real reader's chat. expectedPathways[0] is the routed primary; any other expectedPathways entry or an `acceptable` name is accepted as the primary, and every expectedPathways entry must be routed for a mixed request to count as covered. expectedTier follows the shipped floors in pathways/names.ts and the raise rules in tiers.ts (correction, dissatisfied and wantsDeep raise Quick to Standard). `ask` puts an ask_user card on the previous assistant message (about: the pathway it was raised on). `{{log:name}}` is replaced by ptcgl/<name>.txt. heldOut cases were written before the triage change they test and were never used to tune it.
